$comment: Copy to canaries.json at the REPOSITORY ROOT, not into the kit directory — anything left inside verification-kit/ travels to the next project that copies it, and the drift check will flag it. Each entry breaks one thing on purpose and asserts a specific command notices. Delete the examples; a canary that has never been watched failing is decoration.

canaries.guards: The backlog validator rejects a symptom written in implementation terms rather than in the user's. An entry nobody can act on six weeks from now is the failure mode of every plan of record.
A staleness check that passes when it cannot reach the source reports 'current' during an outage, which is the silent green this kit exists to find.
